title: Beychain dil thay Hazrat-e-Baqar ki yaad mein
body:
Beychain dil thay Hazrat-e-Baqar ki yaad mein
Saamaan-e-gham tha farq-e-paak-e-aiteqaad mein
Tha jashn-e-eid khaana-e- ahley anaad mein
Goya bahaar aayi thi baagh-e-muraad mein
<<MINI>>
Khush thay kay baarawar shajar-e-muddaa huva
Ek taaza gul Ali kay chaman sey judaa huva
<<DIVIDER>>
Din raat ahley shar isi tadbeer mein thay aah
Khairul bashar ka naam mitaa dey woh rusiyaah
Par khalq reh na sakti thi bey Hujjat-e-ilaah
Bakhshaa Khuda ney Jaffar-e-Sadiq ko izz-o-jaah
<<MINI>>
Jo har kushaa-e-taqt karaamat huvey huzoor
Raunaq fizaa-e-taqt Imaamat huvey huzoor
<<DIVIDER>>
Qurbaan malak thay Jaffar-e-Sadiq ki shaan par
Haafiz fida thay mushaf-e-naatiq ki shaan par
Maula toh jaan detay thay Khaaliq ki shaan par
Maashooq ko bhi naaz tha aashiqh ki shaan par
<<MINI>>
Qaail zubaan har ek munafiq ki hogayi
Aalam mein dhoom ulfat-e-Sadiq ki hogayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Raazi qazaa pey tha woh jigar band-e-Murtuza
Karta hai ek shaks yeh wasfey Shahey Huda
Beemaar koyi aapka tha tifl mehlaqaa
Daulat saraa pey uski ayaadat ko main gaya
<<MINI>>
Hazrat khadey huvey thay jhuka main salaam ko
Paaya magar udaas Imam-e-anaam ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Andar gaye huzoor main tehraa raha wahin
Dekha yeh wapasi mein kay gham ka asar nahin
Main ney kaha kay shaad rakhey Rab-ul-alameen
Shehzaada khairiyat sey hai aye Baadshahey deen
<<MINI>>
Farmaaya woh mareez jahaan sey guzar gaya
Ladkay ka haal dekh kay aaya hoon margayaa
<<DIVIDER>>
Poocha kay pehley ranj tha ab kyun nahin malaal
Boley hum Ahleybait-e-Nabi ka yahi hai haal
Gham ka dum-e-nuzool bhalaa kartey hain khayaal
Naazil woh hogayi toh kiya shukr-e-Zuljalaal
<<MINI>>
Tasleem kis tarha na Raza kibriya ki ho
Bandey ka dakhl kya jo mashiyat Khuda ki ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Masoom ki qazaa-e-ilaahi pey thi nazar
Kyun kar na ho Hussain sey saber kay thay jigar
Hai aashkar himmatey Shabbir-e-naamwar
Pardes mein lutaa diya aabaad apna ghar
<<MINI>>
Raah-e-Khuda mein dil ko sambhaala Imam ney
Aulaad zibhaa hogayi aankhon kay saamney
<<DIVIDER>>
Baqar kay laqtey dil ko na aya kabhi ghazab
Taabay Khuda kay hukm ka tha Sarwar-e-arab
Karta tha sabr naasir-e-deen-e-habib-e-Rab
Deta tha sadmey aapko mansoor-e-bey adab
<<MINI>>
Firoun-e-asr phir gaya fakhrey kaleem sey
Keena tha sang saqht ko durr-e-yateem sey
<<DIVIDER>>
Rehti thi usko shaam-o-saher fikr-e-qatl-e-Shah
Jalta tha aaftab-e-Imaamat sey rusiyaah
Thi arzoo kay khana-e-Hyder ho phir tabaah
Hon bey Imam khaadim-e-Sultan-e-deen panaah
<<MINI>>
Saadaat mubtelaa-e-balaa-e-azeem ho
Jaffer ho qatl Moosi-e-Kazim yateem ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Zaalim ko bey gunaah sey manzoor thi daghaa
Makkaar ney Iraq mein aakhir talab kiya
Karta raha iraada-e-qatl-e-Shahey Huda
Aijaz taaza dekh kay kar deyta thaa rehaa
<<MINI>>
Tegh-e-sitam nikalta tha jab niyam sey
Chal sakta tha na zor dua-e-Imam sey
<<DIVIDER>>
Sadh haif sang dil ko na kuch iska tha khayaal
Mehmaan maraa hai gulshan-e-Baqar ka naunehaal
Mansoor ka bhi tark-e-wafaa mein wahi tha haal
Jaisey yazeed-o-Ibney ziyaad zaboon khisaal
<<MINI>>
Kis tarha zaalimon ney sataaya Hussain ko
Loota bulaa kay ghar sey Shahey Mashraqain ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Haq kay wali ka dushman-e-jaani tha rusiyaa
Sab aafaton sey bachkay watan mein jab aaye Shah
Woh zulm hogaya kay Madina huva tabaa
Angoor mein Imam ko dilwaaya zehar aah
<<MINI>>
Sarw-e-riyaaz-e-deen ka ajab haal hogaya
Sar sabz baagh-e-deen ka pamaal hogayaa
